Explanation: Adds a checkbox to a page. The name is the label a person sees and the name a screen reader says.
Returns true if the checkbox is checked and false if it is not.
Checks (true) or unchecks (false) the checkbox from code.
Finds a checkbox on a page by its name.
Gives the checkbox extra text for screen readers.
Runs the behavior's Run action when the box is checked and its Dispose action when the box is unchecked.
